judgment_summary.hud_confuser_games: 3/3 recovered (bp35 row63, lf52 row0, tu93 row63 -- the exact bars the model mistook for the goal)
judgment_summary.mover_navigate_games: 2/2 recovered (sc25, ls20 color-9 avatar, high alignment + strong evidence)
residuals: cn04 mover false-positive: a scattered non-entity color (0) selected; needs a connected-compact-blob requirement, not just an area guard
sc25 meter missed: 0.63 change-rate is below the near-every-action bar and not position-independent enough
r11l/ft09 under-explored (8 transitions): the fixed exploration plan is filtered by per-game action availability; needs per-game action adaptation (harness, not detector)
tu93 token mover missed: the scripted exploration did not translate the token; needs a move set that actually moves it

headline: Real-frame validation (no LLM): the refined HUD detector recovers the confuser-bar on ALL 3 games where the winner-recipe model fixated on it (bp35 row63, lf52 row0, tu93 row63), and the mover detector recovers the player on BOTH navigate games (sc25, ls20). These are exactly the perceptual facts the oracle ablation (REQ-ARC-WMTE-5832) showed flip goal induction. Known residuals: a scattered-color mover false-positive (cn04), one partial-rate meter missed (sc25), and 2 under-explored games (harness).
